consequence.statement: Only the 'live' DNS tests moved to a separate package, to contain test flakiness and improve developer UX; nothing changes for operators.

assertion.statement: In cert-manager 1.17.0, the 'live' DNS tests were moved into a separate package to contain test flakiness and improve developer UX; this is an internal test change with no operational effect.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The change only reorganises the internal test code, and no subject family (config, API, flag, image, etc.) fits it.; change: Moving test code into another package is not a change to anything an operator can configure or deploy, so no change type applies.; applicability: There is no deployed subject, so no condition in a customer environment can be exposed to this test reorganisation.
